Name: Mouse Hat in Shipping Bin
Author: PakRT
Description:
Inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1852]Morris in Shipping Bin mod[/url], I present to you mouse hat in shipping bin mod ! Now you don't have to worry about your greedy mayor Lewis taking commissions from your shipped item (Maybe careful with your shipped cheese)
[i][size=2]
Disclaimer: Lewis doesnt actually take comission from your shipping item

[/size][/i][size=2][size=3]This mod requires latest ver. of SMAPI and Content Patcher. I've made two versions compatible for 1.2 and 1.3 beta; the only difference is 1.3 beta version also modifies additional shipping bin that Robin can build for you[/size][/size][i][size=2]
[/size][/i]
